Be exhaustive and precise with terminology. Write a structured, dense technical section (not shallow bullet mentions) for each of the two areas. Return the full written text as your output, organized with clear headers per area.

arguments.objective: Write a rigorous technical deep-dive covering: (8) crash recovery.
